note: USFS campground on the West Dolores River at ~7,800 ft, ~21 mi north of Dolores via Hwy 145 and gravel FR 535, a mile past Mavreeso. The steep, narrow stretch of FR 535 that the Forest Service says is not recommended for trailers is its last 6 miles toward Rico, well beyond the campground. Mostly shady, level sites under spruce and fir; site 4E sits on the riverbank. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov (233251) API/rates/catalog: confirmed 18 sites, max 35 (FS), 30-amp electric, potable water, $32 base ($43 electric, 2026-2028), reservable with FCFS sites; added pull-through (site 12), toilets, season May-Sept, booking (10 reservable, 4-day cutoff, 14 nights, reservation season 05-08 to 09-19). Note cleaned of field facts.
flags: Phone: none stored. Dolores Ranger District / Tres Rios BLM Field Office (970) 882-7296 (FS West Dolores page, Office Contact Information). recreation.gov's '(661) 702-1420' and rlynd@goexplorus.com are the concessionaire's (Explorus). Suggest 970-882-7296.

Electric count: FS and recreation.gov's description say 7 electric sites; the per-site catalog has 6 (03E, 04E, 05E reservable; 6E, 10E, 14E first-come), all 30-amp, none named host. Three public reservable 30-amp sites, so electric 30 stands.
Length conflict (minor): FS 'Max RV size = 35 ft'; the catalog lists 35-65 ft (01 at 65, 15 at 60, 04E/05E/08/09 at 45). Recorded 35 (agency). Every figure is over 23 ft.

Road: FS 'The road has a gravel surface, but the last 6 miles are steep, narrow, and not recommended for trailers' - of 32 miles from Hwy 145 to the highway north of Rico; the campground is ~7.5 miles in from the Dolores end ('Turn left onto West Dolores Road, FR #535 and continue for approximately 7.5 miles'), so the restricted section is ~18 miles past it. Confirmed beyond the campground.

Flood (Oct 22-25, 2026): the San Juan NF conditions page (updated 10/27/26) Dolores Ranger District table 'As of October 25, 2026' lists 'West Dolores / Meadows* 535 Open No gate; weather dependent' ('These roads do not have a gate therefore are not regularly monitored. Please call (970) 882-7296'). No closure or damage reported for FR 535 or the campground. The FS page shows 'Site Closed' (season ended; reservation season closed Sept 19).
Pin 37.65990,-108.27610 (= FS/recreation.gov facility point) is 45 m from the centroid of the 10 catalog site coordinates and 35 m from the nearest site. OK.

Waterfront riverfront -> creekside (size rule): on NAIP (0.16 m/px) the West Dolores at the campground is ~10 m of channel, well under the ~30 m riverfront bar. Earned at site 4E (catalog point ~7 m from the north bank, under scattered spruce) and arguably 3E (~20 m, under canopy). Sites 5E, 7, 8 are ~30-35 m back across the lower campground road; 1, 9 and 15-17 are on the upper loop 60 m+ away. The first-come sites (6E, 10E-14E, 18) have no coordinates.
